meta.title: Fotis Oikonomou | Frontend Engineer
meta.description: Frontend engineer in Athens, working with React and TypeScript. I've built apps for public-sector platforms in Greece and Lithuania that thousands of people use every day.

hero.lede: I've spent the last few years building apps that real people rely on every day, from Coast Guard officers across Greece to taxpayers in Lithuania.
hero.traceLabel: Decorative waveform that reacts to the pointer

about.title: About
about.currently: Building a classifier that identifies the mode of Byzantine hymns, and digging into EEG signal processing and Brain-Computer Interfaces.
about.p1: Frontend engineer with 7+ years building web applications, the last 3 focused on React and TypeScript in production, most recently on large public-sector platforms in Greece and Lithuania. I specialise in complex forms, shared component libraries and accessible (WCAG 2.1) interfaces built from Figma designs. With a full-stack background in PHP/Laravel, I can take features end-to-end and work closely with backend teams on API design. Open to remote roles and relocation.
